request.subject: UNIT:UNDEAD:SUBMARINE

layers.text: Turn it into a drowned ghost galley submarine: remove the mast, the sail and the rag; the hull becomes long, low and closed, of the same near-black wood, crusted with pale grey barnacles, with the ivory bone rail and the big skull figurehead on the bow; on deck a low humped black cabin with two round portholes glowing bright violet; one small violet lantern on a short crooked pole. Keep the size, waterline, thick black outline and style, with nothing under the hull.
